name: Grilled Eggplant with Garlic-Tahini Sauce, Pistachios & Chickpea Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplants
3 lemons
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice eggplants lengthwise into ½-inch thick planks; place on a large plate. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add eggplant and grill, flipping once, until lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Juice half of the lemons into a small bowl. (Reserve remaining lemons for later use.)
Add yogurt, water, tahini, sugar, and spices to the bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the tahini sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup water
3 tbsp tahini
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: Juice remaining lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, additional tahini, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp tahini
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
3 pinch cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice cucumbers; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl, along with chickpeas, and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
To serve, divide grilled eggplant and salad between plates. Spoon tahini sauce over eggplant and sprinkle with pistachios. Enjoy!
